description:
A Third Party Administrator of TPA is an agency or a company or an organisation that holds a license from the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) 

TPA processes health insurance claims in addition to providing cashless facilities as an outsourcing entity of an insurer.

But the question that arises is : In house Claim Settlement or TPA ? Which one is Better ?
